novaTwoFactor.title: Two-factor login
novaTwoFactor.intro: In addition to your password, the shop asks for a 6-digit code from your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password). After entering it, the login is valid for %hours% hours.
novaTwoFactor.statusOff: Two-factor login is not set up yet.
novaTwoFactor.enabled: Two-factor login is set up. Keep the recovery codes in a safe place.
novaTwoFactor.disabled: Two-factor login has been turned off.
novaTwoFactor.recoveryUsed: You used a recovery code. %count% left – create new ones if needed.

setup.title: Connect your authenticator app
setup.step1: Open your authenticator app and choose "Add account".
setup.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown and confirm.
setup.manual: Cannot scan the QR code? Enter this key manually:

recovery.title: Your recovery codes
recovery.text: Each code works once if you cannot access your app. Write them down or print them now – they are only shown this one time.

verify.title: Confirmation required
verify.text: Please enter the current code from your authenticator app.
verify.label: 6-digit code
verify.recoveryHint: No access to the app? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.

error.invalidCode: The code is invalid. Please enter the current code from the app.
error.locked: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in %minutes% minutes.
